components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Key paint pill for the one main action (Host game, I'm in, Sign in).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Host game</button>

components.name: Feed Card

components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 340px; padding: 12px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #E2E4DF; border-radius: 20px; background: #FFFFFF; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-card:active { opacity: 0.88; transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1F3A5F; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-thumb { border-radius: 14px; flex: none; } .ds-card-body { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-card-when { color: #1F3A5F; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; } .ds-card-title { color: #1B1D1B; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; line-height: 22px; } .ds-card-meta { color: #545A55; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; } .ds-card-spots { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; min-width: 54px; } .ds-card-spots b { color: #1B1D1B; font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; line-height: 28px; } .ds-card-spots small { color: #545A55; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Live Card with Score Tile
components.description: A live game resting on the court banner: orange score tile, pulsing dot, ticking clock.
components.css: .ds-court { font-family: Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 16px; width: 360px; background: #E3BD86; border-radius: 0 0 28px 28px; } .ds-live { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 14px; text-align: left; border: none; border-radius: 20px; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.16); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-live:active { opacity: 0.88; transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-live:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1F3A5F; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 92px; min-height: 68px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 14px; background: #FF6B2C; color: #1B1D1B; } .ds-tile b { font-weight: 900; font-size: 26px; line-height: 30px; } .ds-tile small { font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; } .ds-live-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-live-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #C2410C; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; } .ds-dot { position: relative; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FF6B2C; } .ds-dot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #FF6B2C; animation: ds-pulse 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.5,1,0.89,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { from { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(1); } to { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.4); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot::after { display: none; } } .ds-live-title { color: #1B1D1B; font-weight: 800; font-size: 17px; } .ds-live-meta { color: #545A55; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview:
The screen is painted like the court you're browsing. Each sport's own play area (maple boards, a mowed pitch, a hard court, a gridiron, a clay diamond) is drawn as flat vector art with white painted lines, and it becomes the feed banner and every card thumbnail. Around that painted surface the app is quiet: a soft neutral ground, white cards, rounded Nunito, figures that line up. The paint carries the meaning. Navy is boundary paint (times, selection). Orange is key paint: the thing you tap, the score that's live, the tab that makes a game exist.

Density is a compact event listing, not a social feed. Each card holds a court, a navy time, a title, a place and distance, and a big spots count on the right. Light is the default. The dark theme is the same court after dusk: the surfaces dim under an overlay, the paint stays bright, and text on the court turns warm cream.

The world refuses the category default of photo-header cards with an orange Join pill. It also avoids the anti-references in PRODUCT.md (hardcore or elite, corporate booking). Nothing here is pro-league chrome or a time-slot table.
keyCharacteristics: Sport surfaces are the only imagery, and every one is react-native-svg vector art in its real color.
Orange is key paint only. Navy is boundary paint. Neutrals carry the structure.
Rounded Nunito throughout. Rank comes from weight first and size second. Every number uses tabular figures.
Flat at rest. The only shadow belongs to cards sitting on a painted surface.
Soft forms: 20pt cards, pill buttons and chips, a banner with 28pt rounded bottom corners.
Motion is minimal: native transitions plus one pulsing live dot, which holds still under Reduce Motion.

rules.name: The Key Paint Rule
rules.body: Orange (key-paint-orange) goes only on primary actions, the live score tile, the live dot, and the Host tab tile. Never use it to decorate a surface, an avatar, a border, or a background. Orange text always uses Orange Ink, never the fill value.

rules.name: The Live Is Never Red Rule
rules.body: Live state is orange plus motion. Danger red is for errors only.

rules.name: The Dusk Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, surfaces dim under a dusk-overlay layer at 40% opacity while the paint (key paint fills, court paint) stays bright. Text on a surface uses Dusk Ink.

rules.name: The Separate Families Rule
rules.body: Each Nunito weight is its own family. Pick the weight by `fontFamily` and never set `fontWeight` alongside it.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures (`fontVariant: ['tabular-nums']` via `type.numeric`, `type.score`, or `type.scoreHuge`): times, distances, counts, scores, and clocks.

rules.name: The Section Is the Heading Rule
rules.body: Section labels such as TODAY and LATER THIS WEEK are headings themselves (accessibilityRole header). Nothing sits above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow.

rules.name: The Honest Count Rule
rules.body: The feed headline agrees in number: "One soccer game near you", "3 soccer games near you", "No soccer games yet". It reads "Finding games near you" while loading.

rules.name: The Clear Court Rule
rules.body: Court markings never sit behind the headline or the chips. Markings start below the measured text and chip heights (`top`), and the banner keeps room for a whole court end when nothing is live.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Cards on the neutral ground use a hairline border, not a shadow. A shadow means the card sits on a painted court.

dos: **Do** paint the selected sport's own surface as the banner and thumbnail, and draw it as react-native-svg vector art in the colors from `src/lib/surfaces.ts`.
**Do** keep orange to key paint: primary buttons, the score tile, the live dot, and the Host tab tile. Fills carry dark ink, and orange text uses Orange Ink (#C2410C light, #FFB27A dark).
**Do** use Boundary Navy for times, selection, focus, and the active tab.
**Do** give every avatar a Navy Tint background with navy initials.
**Do** start court markings below the headline and chips, and leave room for a whole court end when nothing is live.
**Do** make section labels (TODAY, LATER THIS WEEK) the headings themselves.
**Do** make the feed headline agree in number: "One soccer game near you" / "3 soccer games near you" / "No soccer games yet".
**Do** use tabular figures for every number.
**Do** select Nunito weights by family name (fonts.semibold through fonts.black).
**Do** dim surfaces in dark mode with the dusk overlay at 40%, keep the paint bright, and set text on surfaces in Dusk Ink.
**Do** build styles with `createStyles` so both themes come from one palette.
donts: **Don't** put decorative orange on surfaces, avatars, borders, or backgrounds, or use the orange fill value for text.
**Don't** use red for live. Danger is for errors only.
**Don't** place a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
**Don't** draw court markings behind the headline or the chips.
**Don't** ship raster imagery for surfaces or swap in photo-header cards.
**Don't** give cards on the neutral ground a shadow. Shadows mean a card sits on a painted court.
